inlines.v: INFORM'AL, adjective [in and formal.] Not in the regular or usual form; as an informal writing; informal proceedings. 1. Not in the usual manner; not according to custom; as an informal visit. 2. Not with the official forms; as the secretary made to the envoy an informal communication.
